Multimodal Retrieval & RAG

Atlas Workspace

Ask questions across papers and a research library, inspect cited passages, and explore connections through research maps.

Multimodal Retrieval & RAG
Official source ↗

DOCUMENTATION-BASED SELECTION

Why it is a Featured Tool

A research workspace combines source questions, cited passages, and maps, offering a direct route for readers who want to use document answers rather than build retrieval infrastructure.

Before you choose: Check source and message limits and citation fidelity. This is not a drop-in retrieval API or an interoperable ontology editor.

At a glance

Input
PDF, Word files, slides, websites and research sources
Output
Cited answers, notes, research maps; PDF, Word, Markdown and text exports
Provenance
Source-passage and page citations; coordinate export not confirmed
Scanned pages
Searchable scanned PDFs are listed; verify your files
Deployment
Cloud workspace
Availability
Commercial
Costs to plan for
Free plan; paid subscriptions

Limitations to check

A research workflow rather than a general extraction API. Verify upload and message quotas, export fidelity, and citation coverage. Research maps do not establish an interoperable ontology.

Build a meaningful sample

Include your hardest pages: low-quality scans, missing fields, dense tables, and evidence split across pages. Validate output correctness separately from citation accuracy.
